dct_description_sm: This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada.This spatial data is Aggregated Dissemination Area (ADA) geography, for the Durham census division (CD). The column "ADAUID" can be used to identify specific ADA's and to link tables of census tables.
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Aggregate Dissemination Areas Boundary
